topic: Steering wheel crooked after new tires? That's an alignment clue, not a bad tire.
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: New tires but your steering wheel sits crooked?
beats.visualPrompt: Interior dash-cam-style shot of a steering wheel sitting visibly off-center while the vehicle drives straight down a quiet road, static-mounted camera, daylight, slight zoom-in on the wheel logo/spoke position to sell 'crooked.'
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2s sub-shots before real generation to satisfy the 1.5-2.5s visual-change cadence.

beats.narration: That's not a bad tire — it's the wheel that's off, not the tread.
beats.visualPrompt: Cut to an exterior shot of a fresh tire being lowered onto a wheel hub in a shop bay, then a close-up on new tread grooves — contrasts 'new tire' against the wheel-position symptom from beat 1.

beats.narration: One clue: the alignment was already off — new tread just made it easier to notice.
beats.visualPrompt: Overhead/top-down shot of an alignment rack's laser/camera targets mounted on all four wheels of a vehicle on a lift, subtle indicator lights implying a reading is in progress.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (wide + target close-up) before real generation.

beats.narration: Left off-center, that pull can wear brand-new tread unevenly.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro shot of a tire's tread face showing a feathered/uneven wear edge (one side worn more than the other), slow push-in to sell the 'uneven wear' consequence.

beats.narration: Don't guess. An alignment check can find what's actually off.
beats.visualPrompt: Alignment rack display/monitor showing toe/camber value graphics (generic abstract gauge-style UI, no real brand/software chrome), static mount, shop-bay ambient lighting.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots before real generation.

beats.narration: Worth checking before new tread wears down crooked. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
beats.postCompositing: Real logo and CTA text overlay added in post via ffmpeg, never AI-generated.
